headword: {無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}

definitions.explanation: A vote in which voters do not write their own names on the ballot, so no one can tell how each person voted.

examples.japanese: {無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{委員長|いいんちょう}→委員長：19385_iinchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: The committee chair was chosen by secret ballot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧しにくい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Because the mood made it hard to object, we decided to put the question to a secret ballot.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to elect by secret ballot
- {無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a secret ballot
- {無記名|むきめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧: an anonymous questionnaire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記名投票|きめいとうひょう}→記名投票：32679_kimeitouhyou⟧: recorded vote, in which each voter's name is on the ballot
- {起立採決|きりつさいけつ}: a vote by standing up, used in assemblies

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese public elections voters write the candidate's name on the ballot, but not their own: the ballot is unsigned.
